facts.business: Golden Legand Leasing and Finance Limited is an RBI-registered NBFC headquartered in Mumbai, engaged in lending activities including Business Loans, Personal Loans, Loan Against Property, and transitioning to digital lending with upcoming products like Loan Against Securities, MSME Loans, and Co-Lending/On-Lending partnerships.

auditor.name: Sunil Vankawala and Associates
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: The Company is in the process of compiling its fixed asset register to maintain proper records showing full particulars, including quantitative details and situation of property, plant and equipment. The register is currently under compilation; however, partial records are maintained. Audit trail feature was tampered with but preserved as per statutory requirements.

key_risks: Regulatory changes pertaining to the industry
Ability to respond to regulatory changes
Transition from conventional to digital lending
Dependence on technology and AI implementation
facts.related_party_note: No funds have been received by the Company from any person(s) or entity(ies), including foreign entities (Funding Parties), with the understanding that the Company shall directly or indirectly lend or invest in other persons or entities identified by or on behalf of the Funding Party (Ultimate Beneficiaries) or provide any guarantee, security or the like on behalf of the Ultimate Beneficiaries.
